## Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes from the repository root.
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files or private company documents are included.
- [ ] Desktop and mobile behaviour has been reviewed when UI changed.
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion behaviour has been reviewed when interaction changed.
- [ ] SEO metadata and sitemap output have been reviewed when routes or public content changed.
- [ ] Deployment and rollback impact has been documented.

## Deployment notes

List required environment, database, DNS or hosting changes. Write “None” when not applicable.

## Rollback

State how this change can be safely reversed.
